# Rafa Gomes

> Head of Engineering at Oak Network. Takes agentic AI from prototype to production and builds AI-native engineering teams, on 19 years of full-stack, blockchain and security experience.

## Who

- Name: Rafa Gomes
- Role: Head of Engineering, Oak Network (global since Mar 2026; Head of Engineering LatAm from Feb 2025)
- Focus: agentic AI in production (cost, observability and usage metrics end to end) and AI-native engineering teams
- Experience: 19 years in software, since 2007
- Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (GMT-3), working globally
- Languages spoken: Portuguese (native), English (full professional)
- Core tech: Go, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Node.js/NestJS, React/Next.js, AWS, EVM/Solana
- Differentiator: a security background (CEH, ethical hacking, threat modeling) applied to building resilient AI systems
- Status: open to Head of Engineering and CTO roles

## Impact

- Leads 25 engineers across 3 countries at Oak Network, an agentic broker for the real estate industry serving enterprise and hedge fund clients.
- Took 4 AI agents to production, live with 3 major partners on a revenue-share model.
- Rebuilt the team as 100% AI-native: moved from 3 long-lived environments to trunk-based delivery, 10–15 PRs per engineer per day, working from PRDs, architecture and security docs, with AI cost and usage tracked per developer.
- At Gateway (later acquired by Circle), built the protocol that reached 1M users, with ecosystem partners including the Solana Foundation, and shipped private computing to production.
- At Accenture Song, managed 30 engineers delivering for XP Investimentos, Itaú, Gol, American Express and Coca-Cola.

## Experience

- Head of Engineering, Oak Network (2025–present)
- Lead Full Stack Engineer, Gateway (2022–2025)
- Founder, self-employed (2021–2022) — crypto products: staking apps, smart contracts and NFT collections
- Lead Full Stack Engineer, Justpoint (2020–2021) — AI that reads medical records for legal discovery, New York
- Software Engineering Manager, Accenture Song (2018–2020)
- Lead Full Stack Engineer, Huge (2015–2017) — internet banking, American Express
- Partner & Software Development Manager, Parafernalia Interactive (2013–2015)
- Earlier: Huge, 6D, Kaus Mídia, Add Technologies, casa56 (2007–2013) — clients including Petrobras
